info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Letter of Credit Update API
info.description: The Letter of Credit Update API allows authorized users to modify the details of existing letters of credit in the trade banking system. This API is essential for financial institutions and businesses that need to adjust terms, beneficiary information, or amounts associated with letters of credit as transaction scenarios evolve. Typical consumers include account managers, trade finance officers, and compliance teams who require real-time updates to safeguard obligations. With detailed controls and validation mechanisms, this API ensures that all modifications are compliant with regulatory standards and organizational policies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update existing details of a Letter of Credit in the trade banking system. It requires the client to specify the fields that need to be modified along with their new values.
